svg.text: PARENTCONNECT — Parent ERD: Notifications and Announcement Delivery
Guardian notification inbox, targeted announcements, and staff-originated direct messages
PK primary key UQ unique field ● required ○ nullable
Announcement source and announcement_id form a polymorphic application reference, so the four orange routes are deliberately not database FKs.
Every connector uses a private route and endpoint; no shared segments or T-junctions are used.
